blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.
blocks.zh: 空间情报要求特工获取视觉证据,将部分观测纳入连贯的三维表达. 我们引入了SpaceScout-V2,通过三个进步将SpaceScout的主动绘图任务从模拟扩展到真实的住宅场景:真实的视觉观测,保存原始场景内容,以及互动探索所记录的视图. 该基准建于Realsee3D的100户人家,涵盖29个类别的3 171个目标物体。 鉴于一个固定的目标清单,代理商会自主选择记录的观点和查看方向,整合校准的RGB观测结果,并在固定的交互预算中反复估计和修改对象中心. 我们使用IoU、IoU阈值命中率和目标覆盖率来评价对象中心地图的本地化准确性和完整性。 对7种前沿视觉语言模型(VLMs)进行评估后,我们发现有6种实现全目标平均IoU低于20\%. 甚至表现最好的模型克劳德·奥普斯5.5也只达到22.52-QQ,只有18.36+X的目标超过了0.5的IoU. 进一步的分析表明,广泛的提交范围可以与有限的本地化准确性并存,而目标遗漏则会进一步降低总体分数. 这些结果突出说明了在通过积极探索真实场景来绘制准确和完整的物体中心地图方面的重大挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence enables agents to understand the spatial layout of their surroundings and use that understanding to guide their actions. When observations are partial, this understanding must be built incrementally [ 41 ] . Agents need to decide which regions warrant further exploration, recognize the same objects across viewpoints, and integrate local position estimates into a shared three-dimensional representation [ 15 ] . As evidence accumulates, this representation must also be revised. Spatial intelligence thus couples exploration and representation: the current scene understanding guides subsequent observations, which in turn update that understanding [ 6 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 空间情报使特工能够了解其周围的空间布局,并利用这种了解指导其行动。 当观测结果不完全时,必须逐步建立这种理解[41]。 代理人需要决定哪些区域需要进一步探索,在各种观点上承认相同的物体,并将当地立场估计数纳入共同的三维代表[15]. 随着证据的积累,这种表述也必须修改. 因此,空间智能是夫妇探索和代表:目前的场景理解指导了随后的观测,进而更新了这种理解[6,13].

blocks.en: Evaluating this capability requires examining both how agents acquire evidence and how they use it to construct spatial representations. Spatial question answering can test specific judgments about distance, direction, and object relations [ 39 ] , but correctly answering individual questions does not establish whether vision-language model (VLM) agents can complete long-horizon spatial interaction tasks. SpatialScout [ 42 ] introduced a concrete evaluation of this capability in simulation: agents autonomously explore indoor scenes and reconstruct their spatial layouts by estimating three-dimensional object positions. This task provides a foundation for evaluating active spatial construction, but agents’ performance on this task with real-world observations remains to be examined. We therefore ask: can agents construct accurate and complete object-center maps from observations of real homes?
blocks.zh: 评价这种能力需要审查代理人如何获得证据以及他们如何利用这种证据来构建空间表示。 空间问题回答可以测试关于距离,方向,和对象关系的具体判断[39],但正确回答单个问题并不能确定视觉语言模型(VLM)代理是否能够完成长视距空间交互任务. SpaceScout [42] 引入了模拟中这一能力的具体评价:代理通过估计三维物体位置,自主探索室内场景并重建其空间布局. 这项任务为评价积极的空间建设提供了基础,但代理人在这项工作中的实事求是的观察情况仍有待审查。 因此,我们问:特工是否能够从对真实家园的观察中绘制准确和完整的物体中心地图?

blocks.en: SpatialScout-V2 extends SpatialScout’s active spatial construction task from simulation to real residential captures. While retaining autonomous observation, evidence integration, and map revision, v2 advances the evaluation setting in three respects:
blocks.zh: SpaceScout-V2将SpaceScout的主动空间构建任务从模拟扩展到真正的住宅捕获. v2在保留自主观察、证据整合和地图修订的同时,在三个方面推进了评价设置:

blocks.en: 1. Real visual observations. We replace images rendered from simulated assets with views from real captures, preserving the appearance of objects and the lighting conditions of actual homes. 2. Preservation of original scene content. Whereas v1 hides unselected candidate objects during rendering [ 42 ] , v2 retains the original scene content in the captures, including both target and non-target objects and their occlusion relationships. Agents therefore explore and localize objects within their natural scene context. 3. Interactive exploration of recorded views. We organize panoramic captures taken at multiple positions in real homes into an interactive environment. Guided by prior observations and the current map, agents select subsequent viewing positions from the recorded locations and adjust viewing directions to gather further evidence and refine spatial estimates.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 真实的视觉观察. 我们用真实捕捉到的视角来取代模拟资产产生的图像,保护物体的外观和实际住宅的照明条件。 2. 保存原始场景内容。 而v1在渲染[42]时隐藏未选取的候选对象,v2在捕捉中保留了原始的场景内容,包括目标和非目标对象及其隔离关系. 因此,物剂在其自然场景范围内探索和定位物体。 3. 互动探讨已记录的意见。 我们组织全景捕捉 在实际家庭的多个位置上 进入互动环境。 在先前观测和当前地图的指导下,特工从所记录的地点选择后续的查看位置,并调整查看方向,以收集进一步的证据并完善空间估计.

blocks.en: These advances combine real visual observations, autonomous evidence acquisition, and explicit spatial evaluation to assess whether agents can construct accurate and complete spatial representations. VSI-Bench [ 39 ] evaluates spatial reasoning over fixed video observations, while OpenEQA’s active setting [ 26 ] and E3VS-Bench [ 31 ] allow agents to acquire evidence for question answering. SpatialScout-V2 instead evaluates the object-center map progressively constructed through interaction, jointly measuring localization accuracy and target coverage. Agents must select informative viewpoints, associate evidence across views, and continually refine position estimates amid non-target objects and occlusions, balancing map completeness and accuracy within a limited interaction budget.
blocks.zh: 这些进步结合了真实的视觉观测,自主的证据获取,以及明确的空间评价,以评估物剂是否能够构建准确完整的空间表示. VSI-Bench [39]评价空间推理相对于固定视频观测,而OpenEQA的主动设置[26]和E3VS-Bench[31]则允许特工获取证据以回答问题. 空间 Scout-V2转而评价通过互动逐步构建的对象中心地图,联合测量本地化精度和目标覆盖. 代理人必须选择信息性观点,将各种观点联系起来,并在非目标对象和被排除在外的情况下不断完善立场估计,在有限的互动预算中平衡地图的完整性和准确性。

blocks.en: SpatialScout-V2 uses 100 real residential scenes from Realsee3D [ 21 , 22 ] , covering 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. The evaluation environment combines registered panoramic observations with reference geometry derived from real captures, enabling quantitative evaluation of SpatialScout’s active mapping task in real scenes. Agents have access to a fixed target inventory, available camera positions, and calibrated RGB views. Each episode allows up to 120 model turns, during which agents select recorded viewpoints, adjust viewing directions, acquire images, and submit or revise three-dimensional object centers. Agents determine their own observation sequences, so each new view can inform both map updates and subsequent exploration. A triangulation tool supports geometric estimation from agent-selected point correspondences, while depth maps and reference annotations remain unavailable to the agents. We use the source dataset’s multi-view 3D annotations as evaluation references and assess localization relative to object size using 3D bounding-box intersection over union (IoU). For scoring, each submitted identifier’s reference-sized box is translated to the predicted center and matched one-to-one within its category. Scores over both all targets and submitted targets distinguish the effect of target omissions from the localization qualitya.
blocks.zh: SpaceScout-V2使用来自Realsee3D[21,22]的100个真实住宅场景,覆盖了29个类别的3,171个目标物体. 评价环境结合了注册全景观测和从真实捕捉中得出的参考几何学,使得能够对SpaceScout在真实场景中的主动绘图任务进行定量评价. 特工可以进入固定目标库存,可用摄像头位置,以及校准的RGB视图. 每集最多允许120个模型转弯,在此期间,代理选择录制的观点,调整观看方向,获取图像,提交或修改三维对象中心. 代理确定自己的观测序列,因此每个新视图都可以同时为地图更新和后续探索提供信息. 一个三角测量工具支持从代理选择的点对齐中进行几何估计,而代理仍然没有深度地图和参考说明. 我们使用源数据集的多视图 3D 说明作为评价参考, 并使用 3D 边框- box 交叉连接( IoU) 来评估对象大小的本地化 。 为打分,每个提交的标识符的参考大小框被翻译到预测的中心,并与其类别内的1:1匹配。 对所有目标和提交的目标的分数都区分了目标遗漏和本地化质量a 的影响。

blocks.en: Our evaluation of seven VLM agents reveals substantial limitations in spatial localization under this real-scene protocol. Among completed episodes that satisfy the scoring criteria, Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest all-target mean IoU at 22.52%; only 18.36% of targets exceed an IoU of 0.5, and just 0.19% exceed 0.9. Its submitted-target mean IoU is nearly identical at 22.58%, showing that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy. GPT-6 Astra reaches a mean IoU of 21.65% over submitted targets but 15.50% over all targets, reflecting the additional effect of target omissions. Tool-use analysis further reveals differences in how agents allocate interactions to image acquisition and triangulation, as well as repeated operations. These findings underscore the need to evaluate agents’ acquisition and integration of visual evidence together with the accuracy and completeness of their final spatial estimates.
blocks.zh: 我们对7个VLM剂的评估表明,根据这种真实性协议,空间定位有很大的局限性。 在达到评分标准的已完成赛事中,克劳德·奥普斯5.5以22.52%的成绩实现了最高的全目标平均IoU;只有18.36%的目标超过了0.5的IoU,只有0.19%超过0.9. 其提交的目标平均值IoU几乎相同,为22.58%,表明广泛的提交范围可以与有限的本地化精度共存。 GPT-6 Astra的IoU平均比提交的目标高21.65%,但在所有目标中高15.50%,反映了目标遗漏的额外影响。 工具使用分析进一步揭示了代理如何将相互作用分配给图像获取和三角化,以及重复操作的不同. 这些调查结果突出表明,必须评价代理人的获取和将视觉证据与最后空间估计的准确性和完整性结合起来。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend SpatialScout from active mapping in simulation to interactive mapping from real residential captures, retaining autonomous exploration and map revision while incorporating real appearance, lighting, and non-target scene content into the evaluation. Second, we combine autonomous view selection from registered panoramas with source-dataset 3D annotations to quantify localization accuracy and inventory coverage across 100 homes and 3,171 target objects. Third, we evaluate seven VLM agents and analyze their localization results, coverage, and tool-use behavior, revealing persistent difficulty in constructing precise object-center maps even when submission coverage is high.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们将空间搜索从模拟中的主动绘图扩展到从真正的住宅捕捉中进行互动绘图,保留自主探索和地图修订,同时将真实的外观、照明和非目标场景内容纳入评价。 第二,我们把从注册全景中选择的自主视图与源数据集3D说明结合起来,以量化100个住宅和3 171个目标对象的本地化准确度和库存覆盖率。 第三,我们评价7个VLM代理,并分析他们的本地化结果,覆盖度,以及工具使用行为,揭示出即使在提交覆盖度高的情况下,在构建精确对象中心地图方面一直存在的困难.

blocks.en:
SpatialScout-V2 evaluates active object-center mapping on the 100 test scenes of Realsee3D’s real-world subset [ 21 , 22 ] .
Given a target inventory and RGB observations with known camera poses and intrinsics, an agent selects among recorded camera positions and estimates the targets’ three-dimensional centers.
The benchmark measures both localization accuracy and coverage of the inventory.

blocks.en: 2.1 Real-World Scene Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 真实世界场景数据

blocks.en:
The real-world subset of Realsee3D contains 1,000 residential scenes, partitioned at scene level into training and test sets in a 9:1 ratio [ 22 ] .
We use its 100 test scenes as a fixed evaluation catalog.
Realsee captures these interiors using tripod-mounted Galois 3D LiDAR cameras.
The released data provide equirectangular RGB panoramas, sparse depth maps, and camera-to-world transformations for each scan position.
Metric depth is recovered using the supplied depth scale. The aligned RGB images and depth maps support the multi-view 3D object annotations described below.
blocks.zh:
Realsee3D中真实世界的子集包含1000个住宅场景,在场景层面被分割成9:1比例 [22]的培训和测试集.
我们用它的100个试验场景作为固定的评价目录.
Realsee使用三脚架搭载的Galois 3D LiDAR摄像头捕获这些内饰.
发布的数据为每个扫描位置提供了等效的RGB全景图,稀疏的深度图,以及相机到世界的转换.
测量深度用提供的深度尺度回收。 对齐的RGB图像和深度图支持下面描述的多视图3D对象说明.

blocks.en: 2.2 Object Annotations
blocks.zh: 2.2 对象说明

blocks.en: The reference boxes are produced by an automatic multi-view annotation pipeline, as depicted in Fig. 2 . We manually inspect each box from at least two viewpoints and remove inaccurate annotations. The resulting inventory contains 3,171 objects across 29 categories, as presented in Fig. 3 . We use the resulting boxes as evaluation references after visual inspection.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,参考箱由自动多视图注释管道生产。 我们从至少两个角度手动检查每个盒子,并删除不准确的说明。 如图3所示,由此产生的清单包含29个类别的3 171个物体。 在进行目视检查后,我们用结果的方框作为评价参考。

blocks.en:
A proprietary panoramic segmentation model developed by Realsee [ 21 ] predicts semantic regions, instance masks, and confidence scores directly on the full panoramas.
Low-confidence detections are removed, and masks are refined using geometric and semantic cues.
Mirrors and glass can cause erroneous laser range measurements [ 20 ] .
The annotation pipeline suppresses pixels on these surfaces.
Masks crossing the panorama seam and masks that combine distinct objects are repartitioned before lifting to 3D.
blocks.zh:
Realsee[21]开发的专有全景分区模型预测语义区域,例口罩,信心分数直接出现在全景区.
低自信检测被移除,并使用几何和语义提示改进口罩.
镜像和玻璃可以引起错误的激光测距[20].
注释管道压制这些表面的像素.
面具穿过全景缝合器和将不同物体组合在一起的面具,在提升到3D前被重新分拆.

blocks.en:
Each refined mask is back-projected using the aligned metric depth and the corresponding camera-to-world pose.
Bidirectional reprojection consistency associates observations of the same physical object across views.
Their 3D points are fused, and outlier removal reduces depth noise and points included through segmentation errors.
A gravity-aligned bounding box is fitted to each fused instance.
Fragments with strongly overlapping footprints are merged, and box centers and orientations are refined using the dominant scene axes.
Category-specific size priors, duplicate removal, and correction of category confusions complete the annotation.
blocks.zh:
每个精制的面具都采用对齐的度量深度和相应的相机对世界的姿势进行反射.
双向重投影一致性是指对同一物理对象的观测跨视图。
他们的3D点被引信,离线除去会减少深度噪声,通过分割错误包含点.
每个引信箱都装有一个重力对齐的边框。
足迹高度重叠的裂痕被合并,并使用主导场景轴来细化箱形中心和方向.
类别特定大小的前缀,重复删除,以及类别混淆的更正,完成注释.

blocks.en:
The source 3D annotation vocabulary contains 102 indoor object categories drawn from the segmentation model’s 130 categories.
Each annotated instance includes its category, 3D box, confidence aggregated over its 2D observations, visible-viewpoint identifiers, and floor index.
These scene-level instances provide a reference for mapping the same object across multiple photographs.
blocks.zh:

每个附加说明的示例包括其类别、3D框、其2D观测结果汇总的置信度、可见点标识符和下限索引。
这些场景级实例为在多张照片中映射同一对象提供了参考.

blocks.en: 3.1 Observations at Recorded Viewpoints

blocks.en:
Each model is run on the fixed catalog of 100 scenes with a shared task prompt and tool interface.
An episode starts at the first scan position in lexicographic identifier order, with zero yaw and pitch relative to its panorama.
The agent queries list_camera_positions and moves to a recorded location using select_camera_position .
All listed positions are selectable by identifier; selection preserves the yaw and pitch relative to the new panorama.
The agent changes the viewing direction with rotate_camera and obtains an image through capture_image .
For each scene, the target inventory, available scan positions, initial view, and interaction budget are shared across models.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate seven VLM agents on the 100-scene test catalog:
Claude Opus 5.5 [ 3 ] ,
Claude Sonnet 5.5 [ 4 ] ,
GPT-6 Astra [ 27 ] ,
GPT-6.1 Sol [ 28 ] ,
MiMo-V2.6-Pro [ 37 ] ,
Qwen3.8-Max [ 29 ] , and
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 12 ] .
All runs use the xhigh reasoning setting and follow the shared prompt and tool interface in Section 3 .
For each scene, agents receive the same target inventory, recorded camera positions, and initial RGB view.
They acquire perspective observations at these positions and submit or revise object centers under the 120-turn limit, with no separate image-count limit.
All evaluated episodes used at most 100 model turns.
We score runs whose final executed tool is a successful finish_mapping call and whose saved reference and prediction files satisfy the scene manifest.
Partial or empty maps remain eligible and are scored accordingly.
Incomplete attempts are rerun from the beginning, and the runner retains one current completed output per model–scene pair.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en:
Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest all-target mean IoU at 22.52%, followed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 18.14%.
GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol reach 15.50% and 15.04%, respectively.
For Opus, the fraction of targets with positive overlap, 66.18%, falls to 18.36% at IoU > 0.5 \mathrm{IoU}>0.5 and 0.19% at IoU > 0.9 \mathrm{IoU}>0.9 .
The large drop across thresholds shows that placing an object in roughly the correct region remains much easier than aligning its center precisely relative to its spatial extent.
Fine localization remains difficult among submitted targets as well: no model exceeds a hit rate of 0.19% at IoU > 0.9 \mathrm{IoU}>0.9 .

Claude Opus 5.5以22.52%的成绩实现了最高的全目标平均IoU,其次是Claude Sonnet 5.5以18.14%的成绩.

对Opus来说,有正重叠的目标比例为66.18%,在IoU > 0.5\mathrm{IoU}>0.5和0.19%在IoU > 0.9\mathrm{IoU}>0.9.
跨越阈值的大幅下降表明,将一个物体置于大致正确的区域仍然比使其中心与其空间范围相对应容易得多。
在提交的目标中,精细本地化仍然困难重重:在IoU > 0.9\mathrm{IoU}>0.9中,没有任何模型的命中率超过0.19%。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en:
GPT-6 Astra reaches a submitted-target mean IoU of 21.65%, close to Opus at 22.58%, but their all-target scores differ by 7.02 percentage points.
Astra’s mean IoU falls by 6.15 points when omissions are included, compared with only 0.06 points for Opus.
This difference reflects the effect of inventory coverage on the aggregate score.
GPT-6.1 Sol shows a similar reduction, from 19.01% over submitted targets to 15.04% over all targets.
Conversely, MiMo, Qwen, and DeepSeek have identical all-target and submitted-target scores at the reported precision, yet their mean IoUs are only 8.68%, 4.87%, and 5.49%.
Their low overlap persists despite broad submission, showing why coverage and localization accuracy must be considered together.
blocks.zh:
GPT-6 Astra达到提交目标平均IoU率为21.65%,接近Opus为22.58%,但其全目标分数却相差7.02个百分点.
Astra的IoU平均值在计入遗漏时下降了6.15分,而Opus的比分只有0.06分.
这一差异反映了库存覆盖对总分的影响。
GPT-6.1 常规 Sol显示类似的下降,从比提交的目标高出19.01%降至所有目标的15.04%。
相反,MiMo、Quen和DeepSeek在报告的精确度方面有相同的全目标和提交目标分数,但其平均IoU只有8.68%、4.87%和5.49%。
它们的重叠程度很低,尽管提交资料范围很广,表明为什么必须一并考虑覆盖面和准确性。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 shows how the four agents distribute tool calls across observation, camera control, and mapping. Triangulation accounts for 20.2% of calls for Astra and 20.7% for Opus, compared with 10.7% for DeepSeek and 10.6% for Qwen. By contrast, DeepSeek and Qwen devote larger shares of their calls to image capture (39.8% and 39.1%, respectively) than Astra and Opus (30.7% and 33.9%). These aggregate patterns suggest that the higher-scoring models place greater relative emphasis on geometric estimation across views.

Their geometric-reasoning share rises in the final two intervals. Astra and Opus maintain a higher geometric-reasoning share through most of the episode. These distributions show how the four models divide their interactions between acquiring observations and estimating object locations.

blocks.en: Table 2: Success factors and failure patterns across 70 trajectories (6 successful and 64 unsuccessful). Success requires all-target mean IoU > 50 % >50\% .

blocks.en: We select 10 scenes and mannually analyze their trajectories from the 7 models in Table 1 . Table 2 summarizes 70 analyzed trajectories, of which six achieve an all-target mean IoU above 50%. All six successful trajectories use observations from multiple views to support localization, and four continue to refine their estimates. None combines incremental submission with continued expansion of object coverage. Among the 64 unsuccessful trajectories, position estimates without triangulation support are the most frequent pattern (39/64), followed by unresolved geometric inconsistencies (21/64). Suspected correspondence errors despite low triangulation residuals and extensive observation with limited localization progress each appear in 14 trajectories. Incomplete coverage and early termination each occur in six trajectories, while one focuses on late-stage refinement without recovering missing objects. The most frequent failure patterns concern converting observations into geometrically supported object locations.
blocks.zh: 我们从表1的7个模型中挑选了10个场景,并进行人工分析。 表2总结了70个经分析的轨迹,其中6个达到全部目标,平均IoU高于50%。 所有六个成功的轨迹都利用多种观点的观测结果支持本地化,四个继续完善自己的估计. 无一将递增提交与继续扩大对象覆盖范围结合起来。 在64条不成功的轨迹中,没有三角形支持的位置估计是最常见的模式(39/64),其次是未解决的几何不一致(21/64)。 疑似函证错误,尽管三角残存较少,并且广泛观察,局部化进展有限,每个都出现在14个轨迹中. 覆盖范围不完全和提前终止都发生在六个轨道中,而一个轨道则侧重于晚期的改进,而不恢复缺失的物体。 最常见的故障模式涉及将观测转换为几何支持的对象位置。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
VSR tests whether image–caption pairs express correct spatial relations [ 23 ] ; BLINK evaluates relative depth, visual correspondence, and multi-view reasoning from supplied images [ 14 ] .
VSI-Bench evaluates spatial understanding from supplied videos [ 39 ] , while Metric-Bench tests absolute metric inference using objects with known reference measurements [ 36 ] .
ScanQA evaluates question answering from supplied 3D scans [ 5 ] ; SQA3D requires reasoning from an agent’s text-described position and orientation [ 25 ] .
OpenEQA supports both episodic-memory and active-exploration question answering [ 26 ] , ESI-Bench evaluates spatial questions requiring perception and action [ 17 ] , and S 3 -Bench combines streaming observations, memory, and further exploration [ 35 ] .
E3VS-Bench studies viewpoint-dependent visual search in reconstructed real-world scenes [ 31 ] .
Theory of Space directly probes the construction and revision of cognitive maps in procedurally generated grid environments [ 41 ] .
SpatialScout-V2 evaluates the accuracy and completeness of object-center maps built through autonomous evidence acquisition.
blocks.zh:
VSR测试图像-封装对子是否表达正确的空间关系[23];BLINK评价相对深度,视觉对应,以及从所提供的图像中进行多视图推理[14].
VSI-Bench从提供的视频中评价空间理解[39],而Metric-Bench则使用已知的参考测量数据对象测试绝对度量推论[36].
ScanQA评价从提供的3D扫描中回答的问题[5];SQA3D需要从代理的文本描述位置和方向进行推理[25].
OpenEQA支持偶联-记忆和主动-探索问题回答[26],ESI-Bench评价空间问题需要感知和行动[17],S3-Bench结合流体观测,内存,进一步探索[35].
E3VS-Bench在重建现实世界场景中研究观点依赖视觉搜索[31].
"太空理论"直接探索了在程序生成的网格环境中认知地图的构建和修订[41].
SpaceScout-V2评价通过自主获取证据而绘制的物体中心地图的准确性和完整性.

blocks.en:
ScanRefer localizes a language-referred object in a supplied 3D scan [ 8 ] , whereas ConceptFusion and ConceptGraphs fuse observations across views into semantically enriched three-dimensional representations [ 18 , 15 ] .
AnchorVLN combines vision-language reasoning with LiDAR-derived geometry for object reference and navigation [ 32 ] .
Our agents receive calibrated RGB views and camera poses, with reference depth and object boxes withheld from the interaction interface.
They must associate physical instances across observations and distinguish a triangulated visible feature from the center of an object’s spatial extent.
DUSt3R and VGGT provide complementary approaches to recovering geometric structure from images [ 34 , 33 ] .
With camera geometry supplied, SpatialScout-V2 evaluates how agents select and integrate observations to estimate object centers.
blocks.zh:
ScanRefer在所提供的3D扫描[8]中将一个语言参考对象本地化,而概念融合和概念Graphs的引信观测则横跨各种观点,形成集成的三维表示[18,15]。
AnchorVLN将视觉语言推理与LiDAR衍生几何学相结合,用于对象参考和导航[32].
我们的代理接收了校准的RGB视图和相机姿势,其中参考深度和对象框从交互界面中被扣.
它们必须把各种观测的物理情况联系起来,区分一个三角可见特征与物体空间范围中心。
DUST3R和VGGT提供了从图像中恢复几何结构的补充方法[34,33].
在提供相机几何技术后,SpaceScout-V2评估了物剂如何选择和整合观测结果以估计物体中心.

blocks.en:
For embodied question answering, Explore until Confident guides exploration with semantic maps and calibrates answer confidence to determine when to stop [ 30 ] .
3D-Mem constructs memory snapshots from posed RGB-D observations and uses frontier snapshots for exploration [ 40 ] .
GenNBV learns a generalizable next-best-view policy [ 9 ] , while NARUTO couples exploration with uncertainty-aware neural reconstruction [ 13 ] .
AREA3D combines feed-forward geometric perception and vision-language guidance for active reconstruction [ 38 ] .
FisherRF uses Fisher information to score candidate views for radiance-field reconstruction [ 19 ] .
Agentic inverse-graphics benchmarks, including IR3D-Bench and SceneActBench, also assess explicit geometric outputs through scene-parameter estimation or construction of object geometry [ 24 , 43 ] .
SpatialScout-V2 evaluates object-center accuracy and inventory coverage with shared camera and triangulation tools.
Recorded imagery provides fixed visual content while allowing agents to adaptively select observations and revise positions.
blocks.zh:
对于包含的问题回答,探索直到Confident用语义地图指导探索,校准则回答信心,以确定何时停止[30].
3D-Mem构建了来自所展示的RGB-D观测的内存快照,并使用前沿快照进行探索[40].
GenNBV学习了通俗化的次佳观点政策[9],而NARUTO夫妇则以不确定-意识神经重建[13].
AREA3D结合了向导几何感知和视觉语言指导,用于主动重建[38].
FisherRF利用Fisher信息为光线场重建评分候选人观点[19].
包括IR3D-Bench和SceneAct Bench在内的代理反图基准,也通过场景参数估计或构建物体几何[24,43]来评估明显的几何输出.
SpaceScout-V2利用共享的相机和三角测量工具,对物体中心精度和清单覆盖范围进行评估.
录音图像提供固定的视觉内容,同时允许代理人员适应性地选择观测和修改位置.

blocks.en:
ScanNet and Matterport3D established real indoor RGB-D scans, registered observations, and semantic annotations as foundations for three-dimensional perception [ 11 , 7 ] .
The Active Vision Dataset benchmarks object detection and active recognition using densely sampled RGB-D views of real indoor scenes [ 1 ] .
The Matterport3D Simulator and Room-to-Room dataset support instruction-following navigation through connected panoramic viewpoints captured in real buildings [ 2 ] .
Realsee3D provides real and synthetic multi-view indoor panoramas [ 21 ] ; Argus uses this resource to study metric panoramic reconstruction of camera poses, depth, and point clouds [ 22 ] .
SpatialScout introduced the active object-center mapping task in simulator-rendered indoor scenes [ 42 ] .
SpatialScout-V2 retains SpatialScout’s inventory-based mapping task and omission-aware evaluation, using real residential photographs and human-reviewed reference instances derived from registered RGB-D captures.
Agents select recorded scan positions while non-target objects remain visible with their original occlusions.

扫描网和 Matterport 3 D建立了真正的室内RGB-D扫描,注册观测,语义说明作为三维感知的基础[11,7].
Active Vision Dataset基准对象检测和主动识别使用对真实室内场景的密集采样RGB-D视图[1].
Matterport3D模拟器和室对室数据集支持通过在真实建筑中捕获的连接全景导航跟踪指令[2].
实景3 D提供真实和合成的多视图室内全景[21];Argus利用这一资源研究照相机姿势,深度,和点云的测量全景重建[22].
SpaceScout在模拟器的室内场景中引入了活动对象中心映射任务[42].
SpaceScout-V2保留了SpaceScout基于目录的绘图任务和省略性评价,使用真实的住宅照片和来自注册的RGB-D捕获的经人审查的参考实例.
代理选择记录的扫描位置,而非目标对象则保持其原有的隐蔽位置可见.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce SpatialScout-V2, a benchmark for evaluating active view selection and 3D object localization from recorded images of real homes. The reference annotations are manually verified. During evaluation, VLM agents select recorded viewpoints, adjust viewing directions, acquire observations, and estimate target object centers in a common metric frame.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了SpaceScout-V2,这是评价活动视图选择和从真实家庭记录的图像中3D对象本地化的基准. 参考说明由人工核实。 在评价期间,VLM代理选择记录的观点,调整观看方向,获取观测结果,并在共同的度量框中估计目标对象中心.

blocks.en: Our results show that broad target submission can coexist with low localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce all-target scores. Tool-use analysis reveals differences in how agents allocate interactions to image capture and geometric estimation, together with repeated operations and early termination. SpatialScout-V2 provides a basis for developing and evaluating models and agent harnesses that integrate visual evidence into accurate and complete object-center maps.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,广泛的目标提交可以与低本地化准确性共存,而目标遗漏则进一步降低全目标分数. 工具使用分析揭示了物剂如何将相互作用分配到图像捕捉和几何估计上,加上重复操作和提前终止的不同. SpaceScout-V2为开发和评估将视觉证据纳入准确和完整的物体中心地图的模型和物剂利用提供了基础。

blocks.en: A.1 Scene Capture and Target Manifests

blocks.en:
Realsee’s capture system combines RGB cameras and LiDAR with nearly coincident projection centers [ 22 ] .
Images acquired at multiple orientations are stitched in the RAW domain, and multiple exposures are combined into HDR panoramas.
The scan poses are refined through global registration using image features and 3D observations, with manual correction where needed.
The released validity masks identify blind regions near the top and bottom of the panoramas.
These registered captures provide the common metric frame used for multi-view annotation and evaluation.

这些已登记的捕获提供了用于多视图注释和评价的通用计量框架。

Each scene’s selected objects are stored in an objects_3dbox.json manifest.

The same manifest defines the inventory for all models, while objects outside the inventory remain visible in the photographs.
An entity identifier combines the object’s category name and its index in the manifest; its matching group is the exact category name.
The localization target is the midpoint of the box’s spatial extent, as defined in Eq. 1 .
A point on the visible surface or at the center of a 2D silhouette can occupy a different 3D location.

blocks.en:

Transient API failures are retried within the current turn.

After either of the first two consecutive responses without a tool call, it asks the agent to continue; a third consecutive response without a tool call ends the attempt.

Submit all well-supported positions now, then use the remaining calls for corrections. Missing targets count as missing predictions. Three model calls remain. Submit any final verified positions and call finish_mapping.
blocks.zh: 评估者在工具执行后分别保留10个模型和3个模型时附上下列提醒。 还剩10个模式电话。 现在提交所有得到良好支持的职位,然后使用其余的更正要求。 缺失的目标算作缺失的预测. 还剩三个模式电话 提交任何最后已核实的位置并呼叫完成_映射 。

blocks.en: B.3 Tool Instructions
blocks.zh: B.3 工具说明

blocks.en:
The following descriptions are supplied alongside the prompts as function definitions.
The real-scene interface exposes ten tools.
blocks.zh:
以下描述与提示一起作为函数定义提供。
真景界面曝光十种工具.

blocks.en: Read the camera pose in dataset world coordinates. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 在数据集世界坐标中读取相机姿势. 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: Read the actual 3x3 camera intrinsic matrix, image size, and clipping planes. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 读取实际的3x3相机内在矩阵,图像大小,以及剪切平面. 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: Rotate the camera by relative yaw and pitch in degrees. Positive yaw turns counterclockwise viewed from above; positive pitch looks upward. The arguments yaw_deg and pitch_deg are numeric rotation increments in degrees.
blocks.zh: 由相对的yaw旋转相机,按度旋转。 正弦反时针从上面看;正弦向上看。 参数 yaw_deg 和 pitch_deg 是以度为单位的数值旋转递增 。

blocks.en: Capture the camera’s current RGB image. The PNG is saved locally and the image is sent to your vision input. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 抓取相机当前的 RGB 图像 。 PNG 是本地保存的, 图像被发送到您的视觉输入 。 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: List every target entity ID and category in this room. No locations are revealed. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 列出本会议室的每个目标实体识别和类别。 没有发现任何地点。 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: Estimate one entity’s absolute 3D center from the same image point marked in two or more captured frames taken from different camera positions. Returns the least-squares ray intersection and ray mismatch; no ground truth is used. The arguments are an entity id and an observations list with at least two entries. Each entry contains a captured frame filename and a two-number pixel_xy array.
blocks.zh: 估计一个实体的绝对三维中心从两个或两个以上从不同相机位置取取的框标记的同一图像点上。 返回最小平方射线交叉和射线不匹配;没有使用地面真理。 参数是一个实体ID和一个至少有两个条目的观察列表. 每个条目包含一个捕获的框架文件名和一个双数像素_xy阵列.

blocks.en: Submit object centers in dataset world coordinates in meters. Use exact entity IDs; batches can be updated. The predictions argument is a list of records, each containing an entity id and a three-number xyz_m array.
blocks.zh: 在数据集世界坐标中以米表示对象中心。 使用精确的实体ID;批次可以更新. 预测参数是一个记录列表,每个记录包含一个实体id和一个3个数字的xyz_m数组.

blocks.en: Finish exploration and score all submitted positions. Missing IDs count as missing predictions. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 完成勘探并给所有提交的位置打分。 缺失的ID算作缺失的预测. 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: List every available camera point ID and its absolute xyz coordinates in meters. This tool takes no arguments.
blocks.zh: 列出每个可用的相机点ID及其以米计的绝对xyz坐标. 此工具不需要参数 。

blocks.en: Move to an available camera point by its exact ID. Orientation remains unchanged relative to the panorama. The id argument is a camera-position identifier returned by list_camera_positions .
blocks.zh: 移动到一个可用的相机点 以其确切的ID。 相对于全景,方向保持不变。 id 参数是一个通过list_camera_positions返回的相机位置标识符 。
